notes:
What's new

- Update settings are now visible: check automatically, download in the background, and install when I exit.
- Install when I exit survives a restart and runs on a real exit, including from the tray.
- Long release notes scroll in the update window instead of being cut off.
- The update log is capped and the release check works even on networks where Windows networking stalls.
- CI now verifies the update engine and a real render on every push.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.7 - update settings and polish: General settings expose auto-check, background download and install-on-exit; install-on-exit persists and applies on real exit; scrollable release notes; capped update log; CI runs an offline update self-test and a render smoke test.
